When the chain dries out, these protective layers break down, exposing the metal to the elements, which leads to increased friction, premature wear on the links, and eventually, a need for replacement sooner than expected.

When the chain dries out, the metal components begin to rub against each other directly, which causes wear and tear on the chain links and the corresponding parts of the bike.
